title: Card Payments toward Resident Coinsurance — Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage
content:
Under Medicare Part A Skilled Nursing Facility Coverage, the resident or the representative may pay the resident's coinsurance by credit or debit card during the call. A card payment is applied to the resident's original coinsurance charge for the coverage's latest booked coinsurance block, and the card payment is the amount that settles the resident's share of that block not yet paid.

**When a card payment may be taken.** A card payment toward a coinsurance block is taken only after the records carry a resident coinsurance charge for the coverage's latest booked coinsurance block, whenever that block's covered days take a resident share above nothing under the split in effect on them.

Whether a card payment may be taken at all is settled by the base posting rule, which this policy leaves unchanged: once the resident has had the returned-payment limit of dishonored payments within the rolling lookback of calendar months ending on the payment date, only certified funds are accepted from the resident on any coverage episode, so no card payment is taken; this policy prices the card payment only where one may be taken.

## Payment tool: `pay_coinsurance_by_card_ebeca5a6`

**Capability.** Records one card payment by the resident or the representative, made with their own credit or debit card during the call, dated today and applied to the one named resident coinsurance charge; it lowers the episode's open coinsurance balance by the amount paid, and the payer sees the payment on the resident's account immediately.

**How it is invoked.** This is a customer-side tool: the agent unlocks it and hands it over, and the customer themselves — the resident or the representative — runs it with their own card.

| Parameter | Meaning | Format |
|---|---|---|
| `medicare_coverage_id` | The reference number of the Medicare Part A coverage episode the charge belongs to, as the business office reads it from the resident's coverage episode | Id |
| `charge_entry_id` | The reference number of the resident coinsurance charge entry being paid, as the business office reads it from the episode's Medicare billing history and gives it to the payer | Id |
| `amount` | The amount paid by card | USD, 2 decimal places, positive, passed already rounded to the cent |

**Return.** On success the receipt reads: status "paid" (the card payment now stands on the account); the payment entry's reference number; the charge the payment is applied to; payment method "card"; the amount paid; today's date (YYYY-MM-DD); and the episode's open coinsurance balance across every liable party including this payment. A non-positive amount returns an error.
